# nodus-flow

> FlowDefinition/FlowNode/FlowEdge, FlowStatus/FlowRun, SchedulerEngine (priority queue + WAIT/RESUME), FlowExecutor, FlowRehydrator.
> Part of the [Masterplan Infinite Weave](https://www.the-master-plan.com/) ecosystem.
> Created by Shawn Knight.

**Notes:** A standalone asyncio DAG runner. **Not** the engine behind the Nodus
`workflow` keyword — that ships inside nodus-lang as `nodus_lang_workflow` and is
not separately installable. This library's design came from aindy-runtime; it
shares no code with nodus-lang and does not depend on it. Renamed from
`nodus-workflow` at v0.2.0 because the old name misled a source-level audit of
Nodus (nodus-lang#483).

## Status

v0.2.0 — renamed from `nodus-workflow` (published on PyPI as 0.1.0 under the old
name). All GitHub repos aligned at github.com/Masterplanner25.

## Install

```
pip install nodus-flow
pip install -e . --no-deps  # dev install
```
